body:
Adds the four Pass–shelat chapter 5–8 statement prongs and PAC support to the campaign base, with public reading interfaces, composition bridges and topic/root exports. Designated security proofs remain admitted for fills after each prong's statement gate closes.

Scope: authentication; OT, garbling and honest-but-curious secure computation; private-key CPA/CCA2 and public-key CPA games; sequential ZK and quantitative 3COL; extraction, learning and BPP bridges. OT retains canonical encryption, evaluator efficiency and enhanced-hard-core premises. No public-key CCA2 construction is claimed.

Verification at `3f6db40e1688c4a0bb922c9575dd3bd2157a650b`, checked ancestor `eee107e92a7db11f1f8c98a5c2867304f57ddc54`:

- All 467 native source/object/direct-prerequisite records reconcile after 180+2 affected checks. This reuses verified same-chat objects; it is not a second cold build. The root export is byte/import pinned and was not elaborated.
- All 54 full-source seal harnesses validate. Source outcomes are 37 passing modules and 17 failing shared/base modules: 138 retained diagnostics in 110 byte-identical old header/proof blocks. Operative contexts were reviewed; no new/touched failing block or home-induced read was identified. All eleven sensitivity/reader controls verify.
- The fresh collector has 2,881 actual axiom identities: 2,835 standard-only and the same 46 admitted-dependent identities as the initial survey (33 direct statement admissions, 13 derived dependencies). No unexpected axioms. Lexical sorry count is 511→544.
- Full explicit-source review, fresh scanner/supplement and exact-identity C3 census identify zero new/touched foreign-body reads. All inherited reads and three old equation-reference pairs remain recorded. The scanner's ten named-open omissions are supplied by the exhaustive source review.
- Style has ten inherited findings and zero new findings across all 61 changed Lean files. All four complete prongs pass plain/check8b campaign checks. Source/API reviews preserve the premises and algorithms, with five equivalent Fin/coin helper reparameterizations and an equivalent shared decoder delegation.

[Final common evidence and precise limits](https://github.com/Shilun-Allan-Li/tcslib/blob/c81baa7712ab1b43357276ef5df138d02616c9d0/briefs/pass-shelat-ch5-8/maintainer/gate06-integration-2026-11-06/FINAL-EVIDENCE.md).

**Draft: not clear to merge.** All four user-dispatched Codex statement audits are now CLOSED at the frozen source above: 06A0B/0M/2 minors,06B0B/0M/5 minors,06C0B/0M/4 minors,06D0B/0M/4 minors.

[Gate06C verbatim findings and dispositions](https://github.com/Shilun-Allan-Li/tcslib/blob/0ab756b8ccb7c37fedd6e5dfbc0248dc0afc984b/briefs/pass-shelat-ch5-8/gates/06-ch5-8-statements/resolutions-06C-r1.md) preserve the exact input pins, historical/native limitations and all admitted proof dependencies. The C fixes qualify the zero-parameter parsing exception, repair adaptive tag-guess coupling and its constant factors, normalize simulated phase counts and lengths, and account for the counterattack's challenge-equality branch. No algorithm, hypothesis or theorem statement is changed.

The [combined unapplied comment proposal](https://github.com/Shilun-Allan-Li/tcslib/blob/0ab756b8ccb7c37fedd6e5dfbc0248dc0afc984b/briefs/pass-shelat-ch5-8/gates/06-ch5-8-statements/review-r1-c/README.md) covers all15 A/B/C/D minor dispositions across13 files. It passes joint application checking and exact noncomment-byte comparison. It remains unapplied; no proof is filled and no post-edit native check is claimed.

The target includes S2/#231, merged at `1aa5506f58f77c215e56d24311ec33bd931cacf1`; S2 is absent from this frozen PR head/common evidence. A read-only merge-tree preview against the accepted S2 base is textually clean, but is not combined-source verification. Comment application and source-matched affected/root/seal reconciliation remain before landing.

Cleanup continuation is deferred at the user's request. Under the [conservative full221-path dependency screen](https://github.com/Shilun-Allan-Li/tcslib/blob/0ab756b8ccb7c37fedd6e5dfbc0248dc0afc984b/briefs/pass-shelat-ch5-8/maintainer/proof-dependency-screen-2026-11-08/README.md), all33 direct Gate06 proof targets plus the six direct campaign-base cryptography targets import cleanup-scoped files; none is eligible for a new proof fill under that reading. No new proof job or branch is started. This is an import-level overapproximation, not a claim that every possible proof would break.

All accepted Lean work lands through PRs targeting `cryptography/pass-shelat-ch2-4`; the user approves/merges and temporary branches are retired afterwards.

**Not yet clear to merge — all statement gates close; comment application and combined-source checks remain.**
